title: Probiotics
description: Fill every surface with harmless bacteria and nothing harmful finds room: competitive exclusion. Unlocks the Probiotic Seal.

puzzle.goal: A harmful strain grows at rate r, but only into the room the friendly ones leave: N of a capacity K is already taken. Write its growth rate G.
puzzle.name: Competitive exclusion
puzzle.ask: Find G for r = @{r}, N = @{N} and K = @{K}.
puzzle.method: Logistic growth: the free rate times the share of room left; a full lining leaves almost none.
